items.q: What insurance do contractors need in Michigan?
items.a: At minimum, general liability and workers' comp (if you have employees). Many GCs also require you to carry commercial auto.

items.q: How much does contractor insurance cost?
items.a: It depends on your trade, crew size, and revenue. I compare multiple carriers to find the best rate — most tradespeople are surprised how affordable it can be.

items.q: Do I need insurance if I'm a sole proprietor?
items.a: Yes. Even without employees, general liability protects you from property damage and injury claims at job sites.

items.q: How quickly can I get proof of insurance?
items.a: Usually within 24 hours. I know you can't afford to wait when a GC needs your COI.
